Notes

TRTEC is the sum of all values of TRTEC_LN. Excludes time spent in activities with codes = 01xxxx or 0805xx. Questions about eldercare and TRTEC were introduced in January 2011. Therefore, cases with [TUYEAR < 2011] will have missing values. Files: Respondent File (the dictionary's File column).
